choices.why: A 198 cm rectangular table in dark brown oak seats six to eight comfortably and matches the dark kitchen cabinets and the stair railing.
Warm grey fabric with a gently curved back gives a classic yet current look, and three sets of two make the six chairs requested; the honey-colored legs pick up the warm tone of the floor.
A large 51 cm white drum shade on a dark bronze frame gives soft, warm light over the table and echoes the dark details in the room.
A brown wood sideboard with cane doors adds warmth and texture, and its long, low shape fits the stair wall well.

answer.why: Dark and warm wood tones tie the table and sideboard to the floor, cabinets and railing, while the grey upholstery and white drum shade soften the space for a dining room that is classic, current and warm.
